summary: Passed. All 164 state-card messages and action semantics matched copy-core.json. The sole P3 ghost-text defect is resolved. Independent checks bind all 36 prior-reviewed source hashes to current PNG hashes and confine changes below every state card.
method: Actually viewed all nine assigned contact sheets in the prior round, covering 36 boards; 11 native PNGs were additionally inspected in that round. The complete historical record and old hashes are retained below.

Independently matched all 36 proof before hashes against the exact old source hashes embedded in the actually viewed contact sheets and against temporary baseline PNG bytes; matched all 36 proof after hashes against current final PNG bytes.

Independently recomputed Pillow RGB pixel differences for all 36 assigned PNG pairs. Each delta is exactly [93,923,207,935] in [left,top,right,bottom) coordinates. findings.category: underlying text leakage at panel edge
findings.title: Bottom strokes of covered sample-data text remain visible below the state panel
findings.description: At the lower left of the main state panel, approximately x140–215 and y930–937 on the 1920×1080 PNG, a short gray fringe of Chinese text remains visible immediately below the panel border. Native inspection and an enlarged diagnostic crop confirm that these are glyph remnants, not contact-sheet compression. The world-options layout still records the underlying sample-data note at rect [93,882,220,56]; the state overlay covers most but not all of it. Card content, buttons and footer disclosure remain legible.
